papers.title_en: Agentic Memory Management Is the Next Frontier of Information Retrieval
papers.authors: Qingyao Ai
papers.evidence: 将智能体记忆管理作为记忆系统的核心
papers.tldr: 随着AI智能体代用户消费、保留并处理信息，信息管理正转向智能体内部记忆管理。该立场论文提出智能体记忆管理（AMM），给出系统级框架，并按常量、函数、算子对记忆对象作计算分类。作者比较AMM与传统IR的异同，规划基准、记忆效用原则及参数/非参数混合更新等议程。其贡献在于把AMM定位为IR的自然延伸，呼吁社区从IR视角研究该新前沿。
papers.abstract_en: Information retrieval has long been focusing on connecting people with information they need to complete their tasks. Recently, the meaning of this has changed dramatically as more and more AI agents now consume, retain, and act on information on a user's behalf. Consequently, information management now also takes place \emph{inside} the agent in the form of memory management. In this perspective paper, we argue that \emph{agentic memory management} (AMM), which studies the structure, analysis, organization, storage, searching, retrieval, and \emph{use} of information in an intelligent agent's memory, is a natural extension of IR research and an area in which the IR community can make distinctive contributions. Specifically, we first present a system-level framework for AMM and introduce a computational taxonomy of memory objects as \emph{constants}, \emph{functions}, and \emph{operators}, each with distinct retrieval semantics. Then, we compare AMM with established IR research and identify their difference and connections. Last but not least, we outline a research agenda covering benchmarks, candidate principles of memory utility, optimization procedures that mix parametric and non-parametric updates, and more. We hope this paper could attract more people, both inside and outside the IR communities, to think more about AMM problems and research from IR perspectives.

papers.title_en: Learning to Remember: Advances in Memory Mechanisms for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Chenye Han, Hongche Yu, Mengyue Wu, Dell Zhang, Jixiang Luo
papers.evidence: 系统梳理大模型智能体记忆机制与系统的综述
papers.tldr: LLM 受限于固定上下文窗口、无状态交互与静态参数知识，记忆机制成为突破这些限制的核心。本综述按记忆生命周期、存储基质与智能体系统角色三个维度组织文献，把机制分为非参数记忆、参数记忆与面向智能体演化的记忆，并将评估作为独立横切组件。内容覆盖构建、维护、检索、整合、遗忘、治理与评估全流程，衔接概念动机、计算机制、基准与部署。相较偏重 RAG 或长上下文的综述，它为设计持久、自适应、可审计、可安全更新的记忆增强智能体提供结构化路线图。
papers.abstract_en: Memory has become a central mechanism for extending large language models (LLMs) beyond fixed context windows, stateless interaction, and static parametric knowledge. This survey organizes the literature around three complementary dimensions: the life cycle of memory, the storage substrate, and the system role that memory plays in LLM-based agents, while using cognitive-science-inspired memory concepts as a lightweight conceptual motivation rather than as a separate technical contribution or implementation family. On this basis, we distinguish three mechanism families: nonparametric memory, where information is stored outside model parameters in text, graph, multimodal, or database-like structures; parametric memory, where information is stored or accessed through activations, key-value caches, learned modules, adapter-based parameterizations, or model weights; and memory for agent evolution, where stored experiences support reinforcement learning, continual learning, procedural reuse, context engineering, and agent harness design. Evaluation is treated as a separate cross-cutting component rather than as a memory mechanism. Unlike surveys that focus primarily on retrieval-augmented generation or long-context modeling, this paper emphasizes the full memory life cycle: construction, maintenance, retrieval, consolidation, forgetting, governance, and evaluation. By aligning conceptual motivations, computational memory mechanisms, benchmarks, and deployment concerns, the survey provides a structured roadmap for designing memory-augmented LLM agents that are persistent, adaptive, auditable, and safe to update over time.

papers.title_en: ClawMMU: Protection-Coherent Virtual Memory for Stateful LLM Agents
papers.authors: Jinhao Hu, Bardia Mohammadi, Mofasshara Binte Rafique, Lars Henning Klein, Akhil Arora, Ashvin Goel, Laurent Bindschaedler
papers.evidence: 面向有状态LLM智能体长期记忆的保护层
papers.tldr: 长期记忆让有状态LLM智能体可复用网页与工具结果，但现有运行框架不记录记忆的权限归属，隐藏指令可能被当成用户指令。ClawMMU为每段记忆标注所有者、作用域、来源与权限，并在内容进入上下文、写入存储、从存储返回及触发工具调用时检查。其核心规则是信息可提升权限，权限不能自我提升。由于检查依据来源而非内容语义，记忆攻击可转化为框架可拦截的经典保护故障。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents keep long-term memory, much of which comes from web pages and tool results. Agent harnesses, the software that runs the model, do not record who may act on this memory, so an instruction hidden in a fetched page can be treated as the user's own instruction. We propose ClawMMU, a protection layer that labels every piece of memory with its owner, scope, origins, and authority. ClawMMU checks these labels whenever content enters the model's context, is written to storage, returns from storage, or drives a tool call. Its central rule is that information may rise in authority, but authority never lifts itself. Because the checks depend on where content came from, not on what it says, memory attacks become classical protection faults that the harness stops even when the model is fooled.

papers.title_en: DeclineCraft: A RAG Abstention Benchmark for Jointly Measuring Combined Retrieval and Parametric Knowledge
papers.authors: Atharva Thakur, Abulhair Saparov, Bruno Ribeiro
papers.evidence: 评估RAG弃答与检索及参数知识的基准
papers.tldr: 可靠RAG需要识别检索文档与参数知识均不足以支持答案的情况。DeclineCraft利用Minecraft语料截止后新增特性构造动态弃答基准，并审计模型可能的参数暴露，支持未来模型评估。研究在27个LLM上测量正确弃答率CAR、可答尝试率与答案准确率。结果显示单次检索显著提升CAR，而迭代RAG及查询改写重排会降低CAR，模型规模仅与准确率相关，为RAG弃答评估提供可扩展基准。
papers.abstract_en: Reliable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires recognizing when neither retrieved documents nor parametric knowledge supports an answer. We introduce DeclineCraft, a dynamic abstention benchmark whose unanswerable questions target Minecraft feature additions after a corpus cut-off, with audits of possible parametric exposure. Later cut-offs support evaluation of future models. Across 27 LLMs, we measure Correct Abstention Rate (CAR; how often models acknowledge insufficient knowledge on unanswerable questions), Answerable Attempt Rate and Answer Accuracy. We find that (1) single-shot retrieval significantly raises CAR in 38 of 40 configurations (model and thinking setting) versus no retrieval. (2) Iterative RAG, in which the model self-assesses its context and can request up to two further retrieval rounds, significantly lowers CAR versus single-shot RAG in 30 of 40 configurations (mean 46.4%), with little change in Answer Accuracy (68.5% to 69.3%). Adding query rewriting and reranking to hybrid (dense & sparse) retrieval lowers CAR for all 12 models tested. (3) Larger models answer more accurately (Spearman $ρ= +0.60$ with total parameters), but neither model size nor release date shows a significant association with CAR. (4) Without retrieval, enabling thinking on the same weights lowers CAR significantly for 8 of 13 models (by 14% points on average), and the responses shift from acknowledged uncertainty to premise denial.

papers.title_en: Scan or Index? large Evidence Coverage, Answer Quality, and Cost in Long-Document RAG
papers.authors: Juan Terven, Diana-Margarita Córdova-Esparza, Julio-Alejandro Romero-González, Edgar Chavez-Urbiola, Juan Irving Vasquez, Julian Andres Ramirez-Bautista, Silvia L. Chaparro-Cárdenas, Gendry Alfonso-Francia
papers.evidence: 对长文档RAG多种检索配置的系统性评测
papers.tldr: 长文档RAG中，逐段扫描看似更全面，但证据覆盖、答案质量与成本未必兼得。作者在QASPER和八本教材上比较11种检索配置，涵盖词法/稠密检索、混合重排与全文扫描。书籍上Hybrid+Jev证据覆盖达94.1%，但Hybrid+Decisions答案准确率最高0.892；全文扫描延迟更高，稠密检索随查询复用成本更低。结果表明应综合证据保留、答案质量与复用成本选择策略。
papers.abstract_en: Scanning every passage in a long document seems thorough, but does it preserve more useful evidence or produce better answers? We compare 11 retrieval configurations spanning lexical and dense search, hybrid reranking, and full-document scanning with Jev, OpenAI Decisions, and Cloudflare Clef. Our evaluation uses 396 QASPER questions and 80 questions from eight complete textbooks, with common passages, a five-passage limit, and a fixed answer generator. On books, Hybrid + Jev achieves the highest observed evidence coverage (94.1%), compared with 88.7% for Jev full scan and 81.3\% for OpenAI dense retrieval. Full scans examine every passage initially, yet later reduction steps can discard relevant evidence. Higher evidence coverage also does not consistently produce better answers: Hybrid + Decisions achieves the highest observed book Answer Accuracy among retrieval methods (0.892), despite recovering less reference evidence. Full scanning incurs substantially higher latency on books under the tested deployments, while reusable dense retrieval has lower projected API cost than paid decision-based methods as queries accumulate. Most QASPER articles already fit within the hybrid candidate pool, limiting the benefit of scanning. These results highlight evidence retention, answer quality, and reuse cost as complementary criteria for choosing a long-document retrieval strategy.

papers.title_en: PerMIT: Securing Persistent Memory for LLM Agents via Machine-Checked Integrity Theorems and Scalable Community Trust
papers.authors: Tanqiu Jiang, Min Bai, Sadat Shahriar, Wanyu Du, Sandesh Swamy
papers.evidence: 为LLM智能体持久记忆提供安全防护的记忆架构
papers.tldr: 持久记忆是LLM智能体易受注入与投毒攻击的薄弱面，也阻碍智能体间安全共享记忆。PerMIT以有限记忆接口管控不可信环境值，将释放与使用限定在确认门，并用Lean 4机检两条完整性定理。在Trojan Hippo上观测零攻击成功，在τ²-bench中最多90个智能体共建共享知识库且无直接注入被提升。该方法把攻击归结为可审计确认，并展现社区确认随规模降低风险而单用户验证负担不升。
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory is a largely undefended surface for injection and poisoning, and the same risk limits memory sharing among agents. We present PerMIT, a memory architecture with provable integrity guarantees under an explicit trust assumption: only user-typed inputs and values confirmed at a gate are trusted. PerMIT mediates the release and use of untrusted environment-derived values through a finite memory interface, while preserving agent-driven multi-turn planning and tool choice. Over this finite interface, we prove two integrity theorems that are also machine-checked in Lean 4, which together ensure that environment-derived memory reaches a sensitive action only if confirmed at the gate and influences the agent's behavior only through what the gate displays. Every attack in our threat model thereby reduces to a single auditable decision, which a human, an LLM verifier, or both can make in practice. On Trojan Hippo, PerMIT records zero observed attack success with self-verification and lightweight verifiers. Because each confirmation is a logged verdict on exact content, endorsements accumulate across users, and sufficiently endorsed items become community-confirmed with no further verification required. Under explicit assumptions, we prove and corroborate in simulation a co-scaling property: as the community grows, the risks of promoting poison and of wrongly evicting benign knowledge fall, while per-user verification effort does not rise. On $τ^2$-bench, communities of up to 90 autonomous agents use PerMIT to build shared knowledge bases with no direct memory injection promoted, and the resulting knowledge significantly improves new agents on held-out tasks, suggesting a path toward agents that safely self-improve at test time.

papers.title_en: Reasoning-Search-Augmented LLMs: An Operational Taxonomy, Benchmark Analysis and Controlled Evidence Synthesis
papers.authors: Biswas Poudel, Nilson Chapagain, Amit Kumar, Xianshun Jiang
papers.evidence: 通过推理与交互式检索证据耦合来降低幻觉
papers.tldr: LLM推理受固定参数和有限上下文限制，静态检索仍会导致无依据或矛盾输出。本文围绕推理-搜索增强LLM，梳理规划、查询、检索、整合、验证与停止的迭代循环。作者提出四类架构轴并以学习信号为横切维度，区分基准难度与RSA循环需求。通过受控消融和质量-成本增量综合证据，为统一设计视角和后续研究提供框架。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive emergent reasoning capabilities, yet they remain constrained by fixed model parameters and finite context windows. Even when augmented with static retrieval, they can produce statements that are unsupported by, or even contradictory to, retrieved evidence. This leads to hallucinations, difficulty incorporating up-to-date information, and failures to correctly interpret or reconcile sources. Recent work addresses these limitations by tightly coupling step-by-step reasoning with interactive search, treating retrieval as an action within an iterative agentic loop rather than a one-shot preprocessing step. This study reviews frameworks that implement such reasoning-search loops by interleaving planning, querying, retrieval, integration, verification, and stopping. We analyze these systems through four architectural axes: retrieval coupling, controller design, knowledge source, and grounding strictness. We separately treat the learning signal as a cross-cutting dimension because prompting, supervision, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning can instantiate the same architecture while producing materially different search, stopping, and grounding behavior. We further distinguish benchmark difficulty from RSA-loop demand and synthesize controlled within-study ablations and quality-cost deltas, avoiding invalid pooling across heterogeneous model backbones, retrievers, corpora, and evaluation protocols. Our goal is to clarify the landscape of reasoning-search-augmented LLMs and outline a unified perspective on the design choices shaping future research.

papers.title_en: Federated Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Xiaobao Wang, Renda Han, Zhiliang Xia, Meng Liu, Renxiang Guan, Di Jin
papers.evidence: 面向分布式知识图谱的联邦图检索增强生成
papers.tldr: 现实知识分散在多个组织且受隐私约束，无法集中构建全局知识图谱，导致GraphRAG难以统一检索分布式知识。本文提出FedGRAG框架，用联邦知识路由机制借助轻量索引定位相关客户端而不暴露本地图结构，并用受控披露的证据构建方法把证据子图转为证据摘要以在服务器端重建。实验显示其在检索与下游生成任务上稳定优于现有基线，为联邦环境部署GraphRAG提供新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) leverages centralized knowledge graphs to enhance large language models with structured knowledge retrieval. However, real-world knowledge is inherently distributed across multiple organizations rather than being centrally accessible. Privacy constraints further prohibit sharing entire local knowledge graphs, preventing GraphRAG from effectively retrieving and utilizing distributed knowledge. To this end, we propose Federated GraphRAG (FedGRAG), a unified framework for distributed graph retrieval and knowledge-enhanced generation over multiple clients with knowledge graphs. Specifically, we address two fundamental challenges in federated GraphRAG. First, the absence of a global knowledge graph makes unified retrieval impossible. To address this, we develop a Federated Knowledge Routing mechanism that efficiently identifies relevant clients through lightweight knowledge indices without exposing local graph structures. Second, local graph memory cannot be shared directly because it contains sensitive entities and knowledge information. We therefore propose a controlled-disclosure evidence construction method. It extracts retrieved evidence subgraphs and converts them into an evidence abstract, enabling evidence conversion and reconstruction on the server. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Federated GraphRAG consistently outperforms existing baselines in both retrieval and downstream generation tasks, establishing a new paradigm for deploying GraphRAG in federated environments.

papers.title_en: ColaBench: Evaluating Memory-Guided Knowledge Acquisition in Personal Agents
papers.authors: Wenjie Zhang, Zhichao Shi, Xuhui Jiang, Xiaojun Wu, Cehao Yang, Chengjin Xu, Xiaoning Song
papers.evidence: 个人智能体利用长期交互历史检索并应用外部知识
papers.tldr: 个人代理需结合长期交互历史检索并应用外部知识，但现有基准少联合评估“用历史定位知识”和“按用户情境应用规则”。作者提出合成基准 ColaBench，覆盖健康与日常生活，含349任务、10个档案、13033文档，并用证据图追踪个人条件、文档暴露与答案依据。配套方法 MemKB 以状态摘要生成查询和规则应用，并用记忆-文档链接检索相关知识。实验达86.25%准确率，平均每任务4.07轮交互，揭示多事实整合收益及错误来源。
papers.abstract_en: Personal agents need to draw on long-term interaction history to retrieve and apply external knowledge suited to a user's current request. Even an answer grounded in relevant documents can be unsuitable when it overlooks the user's circumstances. This creates two connected challenges: using historical conditions to identify the knowledge needed for a new request, and applying that knowledge to the user's situation. Existing benchmarks advance memory recall, personalized retrieval, and memory-guided action, while the joint evaluation of these two challenges remains underexplored. We introduce ColaBench, a synthetic benchmark in health and daily living, with 349 tasks across 10 Profiles and a knowledge base of 13,033 documents. Its Evidence Graph connects personal conditions to their disclosures across public interaction sessions, records prior document exposure, and links answer requirements to personal and newly acquired document evidence. We also introduce MemKB, which uses state summaries to inform queries and rule application, and memory-document links to retrieve knowledge associated with the user's history. MemKB achieves 86.25% Accuracy with an average of 4.07 interaction rounds per task. Task-level analysis finds larger gains on tasks integrating information across multiple historical Facts; error analysis further identifies unsupported personal assumptions and rule misapplication as obstacles to using retrieved evidence. ColaBench provides traceable tasks and an evaluation framework for studying how memory guides knowledge acquisition and rule application.

papers.title_en: Lifelong Context Adaptation through Bidirectional Memory-Skill Learning
papers.authors: Tianyi Xu, Huazheng Wang
papers.evidence: 面向终身智能体上下文适应的记忆与技能双向学习
papers.tldr: 终身LLM智能体需在有限上下文内利用不断增长的交互历史，但仅靠记忆仍需推断解法，技能又缺少任务事实。MemCryst以冻结语言模型双向学习记忆与技能：记忆中的重复片段促进技能创建与修订，技能引导的交互再形成新记忆。十个设置中七项比较领先，ALFWorld联合服务成功率达63.17%。这表明记忆与技能协同可提升终身上下文适应。
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong LLM agents must learn from an expanding history of interactions while making each decision within a bounded context window. Memory makes past experience available, but the agent may still need to infer how to solve each new task from the retrieved records. Skills provide reusable procedures, yet may omit the task-specific facts needed to apply them. Because retrieved memory and skills shape the agent's behavior, they also influence the experience available for future learning. We introduce MemCryst, a framework for lifelong context adaptation through bidirectional learning of memory and skills with a frozen language model. Recurring episodes stored in memory support skill creation and revision, and the interactions guided by those skills supply new memory for subsequent learning. Facts retrieved from memory and learned skills jointly form the agent's context, while task outcomes adjust the future retrieval influence of the records actually served without rewriting their content. Across ten settings spanning embodied control, long-document reading, conversation, mathematics, and code, MemCryst leads seven reported comparisons. On ALFWorld, joint serving achieves 63.17% success, compared with 59.83% for memory-only and 50.50% for skill-only serving. Code is available at https://github.com/tianyi0216/Memcryst.git

papers.title_en: ActionRAG: Evidence-Refining Graph Diffusion for Long-Term Memory in LLM Agents
papers.authors: Navyansh Mahla, Sashank Vandrangi
papers.evidence: 图记忆架构用于LLM智能体长期记忆的精确检索
papers.tldr: LLM智能体需从增长交互历史中恢复精确且一致的证据，但现有记忆流水线易在索引时碎片化或合并实体，在线检索也常把初始相似度当最终分数。ActionRAG以谨慎索引结合查询时图再评估：索引调和类型标签并分层实体消歧，检索后构建有界局部图，用查询条件接收端归一化扩散修正三元组分数。在MemoryAgentBench八个确定性评分列上平均55.1%，超最强检索式记忆基线5.4分，查询合成成本低于0.001美元。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents need long-term memory that can recover precise and mutually consistent evidence from growing interaction histories, particularly when answers depend on relations among facts rather than isolated semantic matches. Current memory pipelines remain vulnerable at two stages: indexing errors can fragment repeated entities or merge distinct ones, and online retrieval often treats initial similarity scores as final even when the surrounding graph provides evidence for revising them. We introduce ActionRAG, a graph memory architecture that couples cautious indexing with query-time graph retroevaluation. Its indexing pipeline reconciles type labels and applies tiered entity resolution. Given a query, dual-channel entity and triple retrieval forms an initial evidence set and induces a bounded local graph. Query-conditioned receiver-normalized diffusion refines triple scores using local path structure. Seed protection, hub-penalized flux, and triple materialization preserve direct evidence while recovering missed connections. We evaluate ActionRAG on MemoryAgentBench (MAB), which tests accurate retrieval, conflict resolution, long-range understanding, and test-time learning. Across its eight deterministic-scoring columns, ActionRAG achieves 55.1 average accuracy, improving over the strongest retrieval-based memory baseline by 5.4 points. Under MAB's query-time cost accounting, mean synthesis cost stays below \$0.001 per query on the four reported cost columns, and the sum of separately measured retrieval-side p99 components is 440.7 ms on our consumer Apple Silicon setup.

papers.title_en: FlexA-Mem: Budget-Adaptive Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Wujiang Xu, Jiaojiao Han, Xi Zhu, Qizheng Zhang, Kaiqu Liang, Yutong Yin, Kai Mei, Dimitris N. Metaxas
papers.evidence: 为LLM智能体按预算自适应渲染每次调用记忆的智能体记忆架构
papers.tldr: LLM智能体在精确事实问答与多步任务中记忆需求差异大，现有检索式记忆会漏掉当前查询未表达的步骤，摘要丢失精确字符串，两者混合又需预设预算切分。FlexA-Mem把每段历史一次性写入不可变存储，每次调用按固定规则即时渲染紧凑时间线加细节，无需LLM调用。在AppWorld 4k挑战任务上超次优方法11.5%，147个未用任务上超A-Mem加摘要12.2%，且单一存储即可兼顾两类场景。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents work in scenarios with very different memory needs. A question about past conversations needs the exact facts it names, while a multi-step task needs a trace of the steps already taken together with details that the next step cannot name. Existing memories are each designed and tested for one kind of scenario. Retrieval memories such as A-Mem miss steps that the current query does not express, summaries drop exact strings, and pairing the two fixes the split of the budget in advance. We propose FlexA-Mem, a general memory that writes each unit of history once into an immutable store and renders a fresh memory for every call. The rendered memory is a compact timeline of records plus detail that a fixed rule fits into the remaining room without an LLM call. The detail is either relevant units as raw text or excerpts or the verbatim pieces that best match the query. With one store, FlexA-Mem serves both kinds of scenario. On AppWorld challenge tasks at 4k, it outperforms the second-best method by 11.5%, and on 147 unused tasks with predictions fixed in advance it outperforms A-Mem with a summary by 12.2%. On LongMemEval and LoCoMo, it matches a dedicated keyword retriever that writes no memory, while memories built on text written by an LLM fall far behind at tight budgets. Ablations show that the timeline carries AppWorld completion, whereas recovery mainly saves steps there and decides accuracy on exact facts. Code is available at https://github.com/WujiangXu/Flex-Amem

papers.title_en: ConMem: Counterfactual Multi-Scenario Probing for Resolving LLM Memory Misalignment
papers.authors: Shuning Zhang, Tenghao Ji, Jingruo Chen, Eryue Xu, Bohao Chu, Xin Yi
papers.evidence: 自主LLM智能体的长期记忆存储、保留与检索决策
papers.tldr: LLM智能体长期记忆常误存、误留或误取过度泛化与隐私敏感信息，形成记忆错位。作者构建MemAlign基准并提出ConMem，将保留决策转为前瞻性反事实因果推断，合成反事实交互场景审计任务执行、无关不变性与风险边界。实验取得75.16%准确率、64.15%平衡准确率和65.31% Macro-F1，缓解过度保留且不牺牲个性化。这为记忆对齐提供可审计框架。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is critical for autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agents executing multi-session, long-horizon tasks. However, existing memories often inappropriately store, retain, or retrieve over-generalized, misattributed, or privacy-sensitive information, a problem we term memory misalignment. To study this problem, we construct \textbf{MemAlign}, a benchmark comprising 1,079 curated memory cases grounded in synthetic, validated multi-session conversational contexts covering diverse misalignment taxonomies. We then propose ConMem, an algorithm that reframes retention decisions as prospective counterfactual causal inference. \textbf{ConMem} synthesizes counterfactual interaction scenarios to prospectively audit downstream intervention effects across three aspects: relevant task execution, irrelevant invariance checks, and risk-sensitive boundary shifts. Experiments show that ConMem outperforms other methods, achieving 75.16\% accuracy, 64.15\% balanced accuracy, and a Macro-F1 of 65.31\%, effectively mitigating over-retention biases without sacrificing personalization utility.

papers.title_en: ReSight: Task-Driven Self-Improving Memory for Embodied Agents
papers.authors: Lirong Che, Yang Chen, Yimeng Su, Daqi Liu, Zhenyu Huang, Jiong Wang, Yuzhe Yang, Xu Cao, Chuang Wang, Jian Su, Xueqian Wang
papers.evidence: 面向具身智能体的任务驱动自改进记忆架构
papers.tldr: 具身智能体可利用历史观测回答时空查询，但现有工具未必支持新任务操作。ReSight分离关键帧时空关联与可扩展派生字段，让执行代理和编码代理共享可重处理记忆，并用EDM无参考答案地从执行与探索记录中识别能力缺口、蒸馏可复用工具与技能。在三个基准上，固定执行模型和在线预算时，OC-NaVQA平均位置误差从33.10米降至24.72米，FindingDory高层成功率从38.3%升至63.8%。该工作使记忆随任务需求自我扩展，并在真实机器人巡逻中复用能力、减少在线工具调用。
papers.abstract_en: Robots can use historical observations to answer spatiotemporal queries in familiar environments, but the presence of relevant evidence does not imply that existing tools support the operations a task requires. We introduce ReSight, a task-driven self-improving memory system for embodied agents that expands the capabilities for processing and accessing historical observations as task demands arise. ReSight retains keyframes and their spatiotemporal associations, separating observation evidence from extensible derived fields so that stored observations can be reprocessed for new needs. An execution agent and a coding agent share this memory through different interfaces: the former calls registered tools within a bounded online budget, while the latter uses a programmable workspace and a larger exploration budget to inspect evidence, write programs, and acquire models as needed. To realize capability expansion in ReSight, we develop Explore-Distill-Mount (EDM), which identifies capability gaps from execution and exploration records without task reference answers and converts exploration-derived solutions into reusable memory builders, query tools, and skills, extending memory representations and access capabilities as needed. Experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate effective base memory access and capability expansion. With the execution model and online budget held fixed within each benchmark, EDM reduces mean position error on OC-NaVQA from 33.10 m to 24.72 m and improves high-level success on FindingDory from 38.3% to 63.8%. With the tools and skill frozen, success still improves by 28.3 percentage points on FindingDory episodes excluded from exploration and distillation. Experiments on real robot patrol memories further demonstrate reuse of these capabilities for subsequent queries and new memories, with fewer online tool calls on average.

papers.title_en: CoEvolve: Counterfactual-Guided Co-Evolution of Memory and Collaboration in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Xufei Shi, Derong Xu, Wei Chen, Yanyu Yao, Zhi Zheng, Tong Xu
papers.evidence: 多智能体系统中记忆与协作的协同演化
papers.tldr: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统记忆与协作架构通常静态，难以持续适应；现有分别演化记忆或协作的方法又可能失配。CoEvolve 以技能为中心，将局部协作模式表示为技能，并用反事实轨迹对比产生局部演化信号，协同更新技能库、技能记忆与执行器记忆。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上取得最优整体表现，消融验证了对齐协同演化与反事实引导的有效性，为记忆—协作联动演化提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse tasks. Yet their memory and collaboration architectures often remain static, constraining continued adaptation and improvement over time. Recent work addresses this limitation by evolving memory or collaboration based on interaction experience. However, updates to these interdependent components are not necessarily aligned: an evolved workflow may require experience that memory does not provide, while evolved memory may encode guidance that the workflow cannot use. To address this problem, we propose CoEvolve, a skill-centered framework for aligned memory--collaboration evolution. CoEvolve represents reusable local collaboration patterns as skills that link evolving collaboration decisions to their supporting memories. It further compares original and counterfactual trajectories to identify local evolution signals, which coordinate updates to the skill library, skill memory, and executor memories across rounds. Experiments on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks confirm that CoEvolve achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated baselines, while ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of aligned co-evolution and counterfactual-guided evolution.

papers.title_en: Agent Memory as Recommendation: Recommender-System Design for Long-Term Memory of LLM Agents
papers.authors: Xinyu Zhang, Weiwei Sun
papers.evidence: 将长期记忆的选择形式化为预算受限的推荐问题
papers.tldr: LLM智能体跨会话服务时，需在有限上下文中从持续增长的记忆库挑选少量记忆，选择质量直接影响回答正确率。作者将记忆选择形式化为预算受限的列表推荐，把请求视为用户、记忆视为物品，并提出无需LLM调用的AgentMemRec，复用候选生成、学习排序与列表构建。在LongMemEval上，其准确率较多种方法高10至31个百分点，并以约3.2倍更低服务成本匹配每查询64次调用的LLM重排器；在LoCoMo上优于Mem0和Zep。该工作表明推荐系统设计可为LLM智能体长期记忆提供高效基础。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents that serve users across many sessions must choose, for every request, the few stored memories that enter a limited context window. This choice largely decides whether the agent answers correctly, and it runs on every request at Web scale. This selection faces three challenges: a large and growing store, a per-request cost budget, and multi-session questions that need all of their evidence. Many memory systems build notes or graphs with hundreds to thousands of LLM calls per history, and each is designed on its own, so it is unclear which component yields the accuracy. These challenges mirror the properties of recommendation, so we formalize agent memory as budgeted slate recommendation, with the request as the user, stored memories as items and the context window as a slate. The formalization places memory systems in one design space of recommender cascades and factorizes accuracy into the completeness that each stage controls. Guided by it, we propose AgentMemRec, which adapts candidate generation, learning to rank and slate construction from recommender systems and selects memories without any LLM call. On multi-session questions of LongMemEval, AgentMemRec outperforms memory and context-selection methods, including A-Mem, HippoRAG 2, DynamicRAG and T-Mem, by 10 to 31 points of accuracy. It matches an LLM reranker that makes 64 calls per query at 3.2 times lower serving cost, and on LoCoMo it outperforms Mem0 and Zep without any LLM call at write time. The factorization attributes the gains to slates that more often hold all of the evidence, so recommender-system design offers an effective and efficient foundation for the long-term memory of LLM agents.

papers.title_en: Adaptive Memory Index Evolution for Agents
papers.authors: Yuntong Hu, Tongli Su, Yuanfu Sun, Shuo Ma, Qiaoyu Tan, Liang Zhao
papers.evidence: 自适应记忆索引演化提升智能体记忆检索
papers.tldr: 长时程智能体虽持续积累记忆，但存储并不等于需要时能取用。论文将持久访问更新单独建模为记忆索引演化，并提出轻量插件层AMIE，从部署检索中学习每记忆访问状态并重加权宿主检索。在5个宿主、3个基准的15组比较中，AMIE全部提升下游F1或准确率0.70–3.37个百分点，检索在10组比较中均改善。该工作把持久记忆访问确立为独立于内容的实用适配层。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents continually accumulate experience, yet retaining a memory does not guarantee access when it is needed. Existing systems can adapt both memory content and access; we isolate persistent access updates as a separately controlled adaptation layer. We formulate this target as Memory Index Evolution and instantiate it with Adaptive Memory Index Evolution (AMIE), a lightweight plug-in layer that evolves per-memory access state from deployment retrievals without modifying stored content or retraining the host memory system. AMIE distils a semantic teacher's keep/suppress judgments into a retrieval-conditioned policy and accumulates its selective actions into bounded state that reweights subsequent host retrievals. Surprisingly, even a zero-call policy that simply accumulates retrieval frequency can match or outperform semantic policies in several settings, revealing retrieval traffic itself as a strong signal for access adaptation, while learned selectivity improves robustness when frequently retrieved memories remain useful. Across five retrieval-based hosts and three benchmarks, trained AMIE improves downstream F1 or accuracy in all 15 comparisons, by 0.70--3.37 percentage points (up to 25% relative), and improves retrieval in all 10 comparisons. Controlled analyses show that persistent competitor suppression can expose previously unseen evidence, while suppressing repeatedly useful memories creates the complementary failure mode. Together, these results establish persistent memory access as a practical adaptation layer, distinct from the content it serves, in retrieval-based agent memory systems.

papers.title_en: Hallucination-Aware Multi-Agent RAG via Internal Attention Rewards
papers.authors: Runsong Jia, Qian Chang, Mengjia Wu, Ciprian Doru Giurcăneanu, Jie Lu, Yi Zhang
papers.evidence: 结合注意力风险信号的多智能体RAG幻觉抑制
papers.tldr: RAG 虽以检索证据为依据，但输出常含证据不支持的主张；现有多智能体 RAG 只用 EM/F1 等任务奖励联合优化，奖励衡量答案重叠而非对证据的忠实度。本文把生成器注意力头范数算出的内部幻觉风险信号与任务奖励结合，用 TruthfulQA 校准的冻结 critic 提供互补风险分，在协作式 PPO 中做奖励塑形。在三种骨干与三个基准上，任务表现提升且幻觉率下降。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds language models in retrieved evidence, but its outputs often contain claims unsupported by that evidence. Recent multi-agent RAG systems decompose the pipeline into cooperative decisions, yet they typically optimize all agents under a shared task reward such as EM or F1, which measures answer overlap rather than faithfulness to evidence. We propose a hallucination-aware multi-agent RAG framework that combines the task reward with an internal hallucination-risk signal computed from the generator's attention-head norms. Three role-specific LoRA adapters, a query planner, an evidence selector, and an answer generator, share a frozen backbone. A lightweight critic is trained once on TruthfulQA truthful/false pairs and then kept frozen, providing a complementary risk score that is added to the shared reward during cooperative PPO training. Across three backbones (Qwen3-8B, Llama3-8B, Llama2-13B) and three benchmarks (RAGTruth, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA), our method improves task performance and reduces hallucination rates over the strongest multi-agent baseline. Ablations and critic diagnostics show that the TruthfulQA-calibrated signal provides useful reward shaping that transfers across RAG tasks.

papers.title_en: EMMA: Structured Episodic Memory for Multi-Agent Workflow Synthesis
papers.authors: Ruijia Niu, Kaiwen Liu, Rose Yu, Kristina Klinkner
papers.evidence: 面向多智能体系统的结构化情节记忆架构
papers.tldr: 针对专用领域LLM智能体缺乏任务流程且参数训练昂贵、单智能体记忆易受跨任务干扰的问题，EMMA将多智能体配置视为结构化情景记忆。它让反思器把诊断失败归属到负责修正的作用域，并在该域内提出单次编辑，再由与骨干模型无关的守卫保证更新局部、增量和有界。在KramaBench、AppWorld与BBEH上，EMMA在五种骨干和四个基线中均取得最佳总体表现，最高提升32.5%，训练执行减少17-38%。
papers.abstract_en: Deploying LLM agents in specialized domains often require fine-grained task-specific procedures and knowledge a general model lacks, yet parameter training is costly and non-interpretable, and hand-engineered agent systems shift the cost to expert labor. Episodic memory updates at context level, but single agent adaptation struggles to alleviate cross-task interference, especially with complex tasks such as multi-application navigation or data pool analysis. Although multi-agent evolution alleviates this problem, existing methods lack clear definitions on update rules and rely on the backbone model to decide where and how much the system changes. This ill-scoped evolution makes learning follow the backbone's structural preferences rather than the observed failures: one backbone accumulates skills while another spawns agents. We present EMMA (structured Episodic Memory for Multi-Agent workflow synthesis), which treats the configuration of a multi-agent system (controller routing memory, specialists inheriting a generalist prompt, and per-step procedural skills) as episodic memory. EMMA makes the ownership and admissibility of updates explicit: a reflector assigns each diagnosed failure to the scope owning its correction and proposes one edit within it, and backbone-independent guards keep every accepted edit scoped, incremental and bounded. Across KramaBench, AppWorld and BBEH with five backbones and four baselines (ACE, GEPA, EvoMAS and ADAS), EMMA attains the best overall performance on every benchmark, up to 32.5% over the strongest baseline, maintains consistent improvements across backbones, and uses 17-38% fewer training executions than the most efficient baseline.

papers.title_en: Remembering Is Not Enough: Refining Memories and Learning When to Use Them in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Yipeng Hao, Yuxuan Cai, Wenkai Ji, Jie Zhou, Liyang Yu, Qin Chen, Zhiguo Yan, Shulei Zheng, Liang He
papers.evidence: 多智能体系统中的记忆精炼与使用时机判断
papers.tldr: LLM多智能体可复用记忆，但记忆可能有缺陷或被误用，仅凭团队成败难判该修正还是弃用。DiscernMem无需训练：DMR对照有/无记忆执行诊断并修复规则，BLM记录使用效果学习何时启用。基于Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507，在AutoGen、CAMEL、MacNet四基准均分最高，超最强基线0.51-4.32分。代码生成与符号规划全面领先，CAMEL上PDDL达37.71对28.48，表明记忆需精炼且需学会何时用。
papers.abstract_en: Memory helps LLM-based multi-agent systems reuse experience, but stored advice can be flawed or applied in the wrong situation. Team-level success or failure alone cannot reliably show whether a memory needs correction or should not have been used. We propose DiscernMem, a training-free framework that improves both memory quality and memory use. To improve quality, Defect-Aware Memory Refinement (DMR) compares team executions with a single memory and with no memory, diagnoses rule defects, and tests repairs on current and earlier tasks to guard against losing previously useful behavior. To guide appropriate use, Boundary-Learning Meta-Memory (BLM) records each memory's past uses and effects, learning when its owner role should apply or avoid it based on task context and incoming messages. Together, these components help teams correct flawed experience while retaining useful rules that were applied incorrectly. Experiments with Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on four benchmarks show that DiscernMem achieves the highest average score on AutoGen, CAMEL, and MacNet, exceeding the strongest reported baselines by 0.51-4.32 points. It leads on code generation and symbolic planning across all three systems, including a PDDL score of 37.71 versus 28.48 on CAMEL.

papers.title_en: TrawMem: Reframing Agent Memory as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces
papers.authors: Mingyu Zhang, Zixu Li, Zhiheng Fu, Zhiwei Chen, Jinhe Bi, Yupeng Hu
papers.evidence: 按任务导向角色而非查询相关性组织记忆的智能体记忆系统
papers.tldr: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统多按与当前查询的相关性检索记忆并当作上下文证据，但相关性无法刻画记忆在任务中的不同作用，同一记忆可能直接支撑答案，也可能需链接语义较弱却必要的互补信息。为此，作者将智能体记忆重构为任务导向、角色自适应的工作区，并提出TrawMem：把交互历史组织为局部线程，通过分配任务角色并联合筛选互补记忆来构建工作区。在LoCoMo与MemGallery上，四种开源与闭源骨干模型均稳定优于代表性记忆系统，macro-F1提升2.23至3.14点，且上下文token显著减少。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on memory systems to leverage long-term interactions, yet existing systems typically retrieve memories based on their relevance to the current query and use them as contextual evidence. However, relevance alone does not characterize how a memory contributes to task solving: the same memory may serve different roles across tasks, such as directly supporting the answer or linking to complementary memories with weaker semantic relevance but necessary information. We therefore reframe agent memory systems as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces, where memories are selected and organized by their task-oriented roles and relations. Based on this view, we propose TrawMem, which organizes interaction histories into local threads and constructs task-oriented workspaces by assigning roles and jointly selecting complementary memories. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemGallery with four open- and closed-source backbones show consistent improvements over representative memory systems, with macro-F1 gains of 2.23-3.14 points. On LoCoMo, TrawMem improves the LLM-Judge score over SimpleMem by 4.07 and 4.31 percentage points on Qwen3.5-9B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, respectively, while requiring approximately 12.8% and 5.1% fewer context tokens, respectively.

papers.title_en: Proactive Memory for Event-Driven LLM Agents
papers.authors: Jinyang Li, Zichuan Fu, Xian Wu, Wenlin Zhang, Yimin Deng, Kaifeng Guo, Guojing Li, Junjia QI, Xiangyu Zhao
papers.evidence: 将智能体历史组织为事件、轨迹与规律以支持检索
papers.tldr: 针对事件驱动LLM智能体主动发现服务机会时，现有方法偏重近期上下文或相关记忆检索，难以验证重复行为规律并判断其当前适用性。ProactMem将历史组织为近期事件、时间轨迹和行为规律，通过源事件核验轨迹事实、历史回放评估规律，再与当前条件匹配。在ProactiveStream长时基准上，其F1达52.6%，较五个外部基线中最强方法相对提升21.4%。该工作为主动记忆建模与纵向评测提供了可复用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Proactive LLM agents anticipate service opportunities from ongoing observations and accumulated history. Existing approaches emphasize recent context or retrieval of related memories, providing limited support for validating recurring behavioral regularities and assessing their applicability to the current event. We propose Proactive Memory (ProactMem), which organizes history into recent events, temporal trajectories, and behavioral regularities. Trajectory facts are checked against source events, and regularities are assessed through historical replay before being matched to current conditions. We also construct ProactiveStream, a longitudinal benchmark covering three application scopes, where agents process isolated event streams chronologically under episode-aware opportunity labels. On ProactiveStream, ProactMem achieves an overall effectiveness (F1) of 52.6%, a 21.4% relative improvement over the strongest of five external baselines. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ProactMem-5351/.

papers.title_en: SpectRAG: Weighted Chunk Graphs for Token-Budgeted Context Selection in Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Zafer Sahinoglu, Abdulazeez Mohammed, Buse Yaren Kazangirler, Cahit Berkay Kazangirler
papers.evidence: 面向多跳RAG的图增强检索与令牌预算上下文选择
papers.tldr: 稠密检索难以支撑多跳RAG：独立排序易返回冗余段落、漏掉跨块依赖，导致证据不完整。SpectRAG构建带权块图，融合语义相似、文档邻接、章节层级、共享实体、引用与LLM效用问题相似度，并叠加图谱坐标。查询时先用内积检索与混合信号建高召回种子集，再沿图扩展，用图邻近与谱信息重排，在固定token预算下组装上下文。在MultiHopRAG、UltraDomain与长文档QA上，广泛证据召回提升，生成质量与稠密、混合、HyDE、LightRAG、NaiveRAG基线相当，图谱结构对推理型与跨文档检索尤为有效。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems ground large language models (LLMs) by retrieving external evidence and conditioning generation on the retrieved context. Although dense retrieval is effective for local semantic matching, independently ranked retrieval can return redundant passages, miss cross-chunk dependencies, and provide incomplete evidence for multi-hop reasoning. We propose SpectRAG, a spectral graph-augmented retrieval framework that combines hybrid candidate seeding, weighted chunk graph construction, graph-based expansion, spectral relevance propagation, and token-budgeted context selection. Document chunks are represented by dense semantic embeddings and graph-spectral coordinates derived from a weighted chunk graph whose edges encode semantic similarity, document adjacency, section hierarchy, shared entities, citation links, and similarity between LLM-generated utility questions. At query time, SpectRAG builds a high-recall seed set using exact inner-product search and hybrid relevance signals, expands it over the chunk graph, re-scores candidates using graph proximity and spectral information, and assembles the final context under a fixed token budget. The goal is not merely to retrieve individually similar chunks, but to construct a context that is relevant, diverse, structurally connected, and sufficient for grounded reasoning. Experiments on MultiHopRAG, UltraDomain, and long-document question-answering settings show that SpectRAG improves broad evidence recovery and achieves competitive generation quality against dense, hybrid, HyDE, LightRAG, and NaiveRAG baselines. The results further indicate that graph-spectral structure is particularly useful for inference-oriented and cross-document retrieval, while highlighting trade-offs in early precision, computational cost, and domain-dependent performance.

papers.title_en: ETAMem: Decoupling and Aligning Heterogeneous Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents
papers.authors: Xinying Qian, Ying Zhang, Yu Zhao, Xubo Liu, Baohang Zhou, Jeff Z. Pan
papers.evidence: 面向长期对话智能体的多视图记忆框架
papers.tldr: 长期对话智能体依赖记忆保持连贯与个性化，但现有系统存在异构信息纠缠和记忆组织失配问题。ETAMem将对话信息解析为原子记忆单元并抽取情感信息，构建事件、情感、时间三类层次化视图，并以自适应阈值增量维护。检索时按查询熵分配各视图预算并分层搜索。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上相对准确率分别提升12.46%和7.96%，兼顾token效率，表明解耦对齐多视图记忆的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to maintain coherent and personalized interactions across extended conversations. However, existing memory systems face two key challenges: (1) Information Entanglement, where heterogeneous information is mixed within coarse-grained memory units; and (2) Organizational Mismatch, where memory structures based primarily on semantic similarity may overlook other associations. To address these challenges, we propose ETAMem, a multi-view memory framework that decouples heterogeneous conversational information and aligns memory representations and organization with its distinct characteristics. Specifically, heterogeneous information parsing extracts atomic memory units and identifies affective information. View-specific memory structuring then organizes these units into three complementary hierarchical views: Event, Affect, and Time. ETAMem incrementally maintains memory structures with adaptively calibrated thresholds. For retrieval, entropy-based retrieval allocates query-specific budgets across views and performs hierarchical search within each view. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S demonstrate that ETAMem outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving relative accuracy improvements of 12.46% and 7.96%, respectively, while maintaining competitive token efficiency. Further analyses demonstrate the complementary benefits of different memory views.

papers.title_en: Analyzing performance of Retrieval Augmented Generation models for Question Answering Tasks
papers.authors: Fazle Mohammed Tasfiq, Sabab Attin, Sheikh Md. Tahmid Hossain, Raiat Reza, Tanzim Ahmmed, Nafis Chowdhury, Anika Ahmed, Moinul Haque, Farig Yousuf Sadeque
papers.evidence: 评估面向开放域问答的检索增强生成模型
papers.tldr: 南亚多语言文化问答对语境感知要求高，现有RAG架构虽多但区域适配仍具挑战。研究在南亚多语言设置中比较无上下文、上下文增强与RAG问答流程，并分析文化相关及非文化问题的表现差异。摘要未报告量化指标，重点在于识别高性能因素并评估RAG对流行与非流行文化问题的增益，同时考察检索增强与上下文增强的效果差异。工作为优化混合RAG系统及更准确高效的问答管线设计提供参考。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models have become almost a cornerstone of open-domain question answering tasks; in which the quality of answers generated in the process, greatly relies on the effectiveness of retrieval mechanisms. In the realm of LLM, the last two years have seen tremendous progress in RAG architectures, with many models reporting to have improved performance through various design innovations. The cultural question and answering systems of South Asia, in particular, present a specific challenge since the region is home to the vast number of languages and traditions, which are closely interrelated. Along with these deeply intertwined historical narratives increase the need for culturally grounded and context-aware interpretation. Despite major architectural advances in LLMs, claiming significant improvements, challenges remain when answering these region specific questions in native languages. In this study, we aim to extract high-performing factors to guide the development of optimized hybrid RAG systems. We further explore whether the integration of RAG changes performance differently for culturally grounded and non-cultural questions in a South Asian multilingual setup, and whether RAG produces a higher overall percentage of correct answers than contexted answering. We also examine how LLM performance changes when RAG methods are integrated into the question-answering pipeline in comparison with non-contexted and contexted answering and, evaluate whether the introduction of RAG benefits popular or non-popular culturally grounded questions more. Not only does our work evaluate the current methods but also carves a path for future designs of more accurate and efficient question-answering pipelines.

papers.title_en: Reliable Knowledge Acquisition for Continual Learning Agents
papers.authors: Yixu Huang, Jiaqi W. Ma
papers.evidence: 持续学习智能体的可靠知识抽取与记忆复用
papers.tldr: 基于基础模型的智能体进入开放环境后，需要持续从经验中学习，但现有记忆系统只保留事实或流程，缺乏可靠性校验。作者提出 RIKA，分层抽取事实、概念、程序与元认知知识，并用证据准入机制决定哪些结论进入上下文。在六个任务流、四个模型骨干上均取得最高综合得分。
papers.abstract_en: As agents powered by foundation models move into open-ended environments, continual learning from experience becomes essential. For agents built on models with fixed parameters, this learning requires reusing prior task experience in context to improve performance and efficiency on future tasks. Existing memory and experience-learning systems typically focus on either retained facts or procedures, and lack a mechanism for establishing the reliability of claims extracted from the ongoing task stream. Indeed, we find that approximately 12--33\% of entries produced by representative systems harm future task performance when reused. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{RIKA} (Reliable Knowledge Acquisition), which combines hierarchical extraction of factual, conceptual, procedural, and metacognitive knowledge with Evidence-based Knowledge Admission, which uses source evidence and subsequent experience to govern which claims enter the task agent's context, without additional validation tasks. Across six task streams from Continual Learning Bench and four model backbones, RIKA achieves the highest aggregate score on every backbone.

papers.title_en: Co2In: a Bi-level Memory Incremental Learning Framework with Knowledge Encoding, Consolidation, and Integration
papers.authors: Wenju Sun, Qingyong Li, Boyang Li, Wen Wang, Siyu Zhang, Yi Wei, Yangliao Geng
papers.evidence: 工作记忆与长时记忆构成的双层记忆架构
papers.tldr: 增量学习需在获取新知识的同时保留旧信息，但可塑性与稳定性难以兼顾。受人类记忆启发，Co2In采用工作记忆与长期记忆的双层架构，通过知识编码、巩固与整合协同学习。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet的无样本Class-IL与Task-IL设置中，它以高效内存取得当前最优性能。该框架为平衡稳定性和可塑性提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Incremental learning (IL) aims to continually acquire new knowledge (plasticity) while retaining previously learned information (stability). However, striking a balance between plasticity and stability remains a significant challenge for intelligent systems. The human brain achieves exceptional balance, owing to various memory units that collaboratively encode and store information. Inspired by human memory mechanisms, this paper introduces an IL framework with knowledge enCoding, Consolidation, and Integration (Co2In). Co2In is designed as a bi-level memory architecture: a working memory for adaptive knowledge acquisition and a long-term memory dedicated to the persistent retention of information. The two memory modules work cooperatively during IL. The working memory first learns from new data to encode knowledge into parameters. Subsequently, Co2In performs a consolidation process to identify underlying patterns in the learned parameters and re-express them into a compact knowledge representation. Next, the knowledge representation and the identified patterns are transformed into separate network layers and integrated into the long-term memory. These designs empower Co2In to accumulate knowledge with high plasticity and stability. We evaluate Co2In on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet under exemplar-free Class-IL and Task-IL settings. Experimental results show that Co2In achieves state-of-the-art performance with efficient memory consumption.

papers.title_en: CARA: Causally Guided Retrieval Agent for Question Answering
papers.authors: Weicheng Liu, Xiangcheng Wu, Depeng Xu, Haopeng Zhang, Xi Niu
papers.evidence: 面向知识图谱问答的因果引导检索智能体
papers.tldr: 文本丰富知识图谱上的检索增强生成需要找出真正支撑回答的证据，而非只做文本相似匹配。CARA是免训练的因果引导检索智能体，用加入证据是否提升可答性、移除证据是否削弱可答性两项标准评估因果相关性，并结合路径一致性与倒数排名融合指导图探索和多智能体证据聚合。在三个STaRK数据集及下游问答评测中，CARA持续优于现有检索器，提升答案质量与忠实度，同时检查更少节点、执行更少检索操作。这说明因果相关性评估可使智能体图检索更聚焦有效。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation over text-rich knowledge graphs requires identifying evidence that contributes to answering a question, rather than merely matching its textual content. Existing agentic retrievers adaptively balance global search and multi-hop exploration but primarily rely on textual similarity to guide retrieval. We propose CARA, a training-free, CAusally guided Retrieval Agent that explicitly evaluates the causal relevance of retrieved evidence through two complementary criteria: consequentiality, measuring whether adding evidence improves answerability, and essentiality, assessing whether removing evidence weakens answerability. CARA integrates these assessments with path consistency to guide graph exploration and employs reciprocal rank fusion to aggregate evidence from multiple agents. We evaluate CARA on three STaRK datasets and augment STaRK with ground-truth answers to enable downstream question answering evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that CARA consistently outperforms existing retrievers. CARA also improves answer quality and faithfulness while examining fewer graph nodes and requiring fewer retrieval operations. These findings demonstrate that causal relevance assessment enables more focused and effective agentic graph retrieval, improving both retrieval performance and downstream question answering.

papers.title_en: InsightRAG: Aggregating Distributed Scholarly Judgments for Scientific Survey Generation
papers.authors: Yuquan Lin, Wenshuo Zhang, Yilin Ye, Shuchang Xu, Zhao Chen, Weiqi Wang, Huamin Qu
papers.evidence: 面向科学综述生成的洞见引导检索增强生成
papers.tldr: 科学文献激增使综述撰写困难，现有系统在开放论文与概念空间中检索，缺少社区导航痕迹，导致范围不全、分类薄弱与引用不可靠。InsightRAG 利用作者撰写的 Related Work 判断，沿作者支持的引用关系进行洞察引导检索，重建经验证的研究范围并组织关系证据。它再以最小冲突目标聚合这些判断，形成反映反复出现的作者视角的分类体系，并约束各章节证据。在十个主题上，该方法在范围重建、分类质量、引用支持与参考文献可靠性上均获提升，为科学综述生成提供可追溯的社区判断聚合思路。
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of scientific literature makes survey writing increasingly challenging, motivating automatic survey generation. Yet, existing systems must search an open space of papers and an open space of concepts with no trace of how the community itself has navigated them, leading to incomplete scope, weak taxonomies, and unreliable citations. Our core insight is that author-written Related Work sections contain the human judgments needed to address both limitations: authors curate the citations relevant to their contributions and explain how the cited works relate, yielding paths for scope reconstruction and relational evidence for organization. We propose InsightRAG. Its insight-guided retrieval follows author-supported citation relations to reconstruct a verified research scope and structure the resulting relational evidence. It aggregates these judgments under a minimum-conflict objective into a taxonomy that reflects recurring author-written perspectives in the retrieved literature, guides generation, and bounds each section's evidence. Results on ten topics show gains in scope reconstruction, taxonomy quality, citation support, and reference reliability.

papers.title_en: Industrial ReMEmbR: Scaling Spatiotemporal Memory to Robot Fleets
papers.authors: Jad Yammine, Malek Wahidi, Abrar Anwar, Yan Chang, Mihir Acharya, Anthony Rizk
papers.evidence: 面向机器人车队的共享时空语义记忆与检索嵌入
papers.tldr: 仓库机器人车队持续观测环境，但把视频保留为可复用语义记忆会带来高昂计算、通信与存储开销。IndustrialReMEmbR 将 NVIDIA ReMEmbR 扩展到车队，仅在按需时生成场景描述，机器人端用 Jetson 编码且不上传原始画面。系统按视觉-语言边界切分 Cosmos3-Edge，视觉编码器留端侧、语言解码器放本地服务器，由 Nemotron 按内容、位置和时间检索缓存 token 解码。450 次测试解码均复现未切分模型输出，消除写入时描述生成并支持 PII 抽象。
papers.abstract_en: Warehouse robot fleets continuously observe operational conditions, but preserving these observations as reusable semantic memory incurs substantial computation, communication, and storage costs. For example, explaining recurring aisle blockages can require reviewing video from multiple robots across several shifts. We present IndustrialRemembr, a shared spatiotemporal memory system that extends NVIDIA ReMEmbR to robot fleets and reduces server-side computation by generating scene descriptions only on demand. On each robot, an NVIDIA Jetson encodes video clips into retrieval embeddings with Cosmos-Embed1, vision tokens with Cosmos3-Edge, and reconstruction latents with the Wan2.2 VAE, without uploading raw camera frames. The encoding models are re-used to detect people in image patches, zeroing them out to support PII abstraction for GDPR-compliant deployments. We split Cosmos3-Edge at its vision-language boundary, placing the vision encoder on the robot and the language decoder on an on-premises server. A Nemotron agent retrieves memories by content, position, and time and queries the decoder using cached vision tokens. This design eliminates caption generation at write time, while cached-token decoding reproduces the unsplit model's output in all 450 tested decodes.

papers.title_en: A Small Model Asks Better: Fine-Tuning Query Clarification for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Lihong He, Lucian Popa, Marina Danilevsky
papers.evidence: 通过查询澄清提升RAG检索与证据质量
papers.tldr: RAG在多轮对话中常遇歧义或表述不清的查询，需判断是否请求澄清。作者构建约3900例的ClariEdge数据集，含歧义样本与无需澄清的难负例，并微调轻量LoRA完成分类与澄清生成。该模型分类准确率达96.6%，澄清质量优于多个更大模型的提示基线，且可用于检索前后两个环节。研究强调难负例对区分真实歧义至关重要。
papers.abstract_en: Query clarification is essential for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that face ambiguous user queries. We consider multi-turn grounded conversational scenarios where a user query is either ill-formed or ambiguous in the context of the prior dialog or, more interestingly, it may be well-formed but when posed against retrieved documents there are multiple relevant interpretations. The task is to recognize both such cases and then generate an appropriate clarification request to the user. We present ClariEdge, a new dataset of approximately 3,900 examples that include such ambiguous queries along with negative examples that do not require clarification. We also show that a lightweight fine-tuned LoRA achieves 96.6% classification accuracy and outperforms prompted baselines of many larger models on both classification and quality of clarification generation. Our study shows that hard negatives are an essential ingredient to separate out queries that are truly ambiguous from queries that may look ambiguous but are not (i.e., can be resolved from the context). The same LoRA achieves high performance in both pre-retrieval and post-retrieval scenarios; thus, it can be used in two places in a RAG pipeline as a check before answer generation. The ClariEdge dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-research/ClariEdge.

papers.title_en: C$^2$U in RAG: Compositional Concept Unlearning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Yiyang Duan, Fan Wu, Tiantong Wu, Che Wang, Zhiren Gong, Wei Guo, Yang Cao, Wei Yang Bryan Lim
papers.evidence: RAG流程中的查询侧概念抑制
papers.tldr: 检索增强生成即使生成器受控，也可能经检索证据暴露不想要的概念。本文在固定编码器与文档索引下研究查询侧概念抑制，提出C²U：将画像导出方向经增强原子库路由，仅向原始查询加入有界“编辑减原始”增量。跨五数据集、四编码器、三种子，验证选中配置使 pooled 二元目标 Hit@5 降4.25个百分点，控制退化非正；ArXiv四概念组合经独立验证门与首用测试优于平均方向对照，为RAG查询侧概念抑制提供轻量方案。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation can expose unwanted concepts through retrieved evidence even when the generator is moderated. We study query-side concept suppression with a fixed encoder and document index. Compositional Concept Unlearning (C$^2$U) routes a profile-derived direction through an augmented atom bank, adding only a bounded edited-minus-original delta to the raw query. Across five datasets, four encoders, and three seeds, the validation-selected configuration reduces pooled binary target Hit@5 by 4.25 percentage points with non-positive control degradation and target-exposure changes. Under the evaluated query transforms, it suppresses target density without increasing budgeted control-query exposure. Separately, ArXiv four-concept composition improves over an averaged-direction comparator after independent validation gates and first-use test evaluation.

papers.title_en: AGR: Agentic Generative Retrieval with Tool-Augmented Search
papers.authors: Ming Yang, Yaqi Yin, Zhibo Wang, Xiaoze Jiang, Jingwei Zhuo, Chao Zhang, Quanzhi Zhu, Weiguo Zheng, Liang Zeng, Yunfeng Zhao, Jiaqiang Liu, Kefeng Wang, Yupeng Huang, Kaiqiao Zhan, Xuanping Li
papers.evidence: 智能体生成式检索，按需进行工具增强特征获取
papers.tldr: 现有生成式检索难以高效利用搜索推荐中的异构特征，静态注入会抬高服务成本并引入无关或冲突证据。AGR将语义ID（SID）生成与按需特征获取交替进行，依据请求和已解码SID前缀决定是否调用工具、选取哪个特征以及观测应影响何处解码。论文用特征适用性与信息增益构造工具增强轨迹，并经SID预训练和工具增强微调训练模型。工业数据、三个公开基准和在线A/B测试均验证其有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale search and recommendation systems derive much of their retrieval quality from rich, heterogeneous features, yet existing generative retrieval (GR) methods struggle to exploit such feature ecosystems efficiently. Static feature injection either encodes all available signals or places them according to predetermined schemes, increasing serving cost and introducing irrelevant or conflicting evidence. More fundamentally, existing methods cannot adaptively determine when a feature is needed, which feature to select, or where it should influence hierarchical Semantic ID (SID) generation. We propose Agentic Generative Retrieval (AGR), a tool-augmented paradigm that interleaves SID generation with on-demand feature acquisition. Conditioned on the request and decoded SID prefix, AGR decides whether to invoke a tool, which feature to acquire, and where its observation should influence subsequent decoding, thereby steering generation toward feature-consistent SID branches. To supervise this behavior, we construct tool-augmented trajectories based on feature applicability and information gain along the SID hierarchy, and train the model through SID pretraining followed by tool-augmented fine-tuning. Experiments on an industrial dataset and three public benchmarks, together with an online A/B test, consistently demonstrate the effectiveness of AGR.

papers.title_en: Retrieval-Augmented Online Textual Memory for Episodic Memory Video Question Answering
papers.authors: Raffaele Cali, Giuseppe Lando, Rosario Forte, Antonino Furnari
papers.evidence: 以持久化在线文本记忆表示配合检索支撑语言模型问答
papers.tldr: 长第一人称视频需压缩为可检索记忆以支撑问答。本文基于在线文本记忆框架，系统比较检索单元、查询形式、上下文预算与重排策略。最佳Parent配置先匹配细粒度字幕子块，再向推理器提供完整父字幕，仅暴露少量文本记忆即达56.4%准确率，媲美全记忆与强检索基线。分析表明增加检索预算虽提升时间覆盖，却可能因干扰项和不确定字幕降低准确率，提示应优化检索证据的可靠性与判别力。
papers.abstract_en: Long egocentric videos pose a central challenge for multimodal language models: the visual stream must be compressed into a memory representation that can be searched efficiently while still preserving the evidence needed for question answering. Building on an online textual-memory framework in which first-person videos are converted into temporally grounded captions, this work systematically studies the role of retrieval in episodic-memory video question answering. We evaluate how different retrieval units, query formulations, context budgets, and reranking strategies affect multiple-choice answering on QAEgo4D-Closed, isolating retrieval as the main variable while keeping the underlying generated memory fixed.   Our best configuration, Parent, matches fine-grained caption subchunks, then provides their full parent captions to the reasoner. It achieves 56.4 % accuracy, matching strong full-memory and retrieval baselines while exposing only a small fraction of the textual memory at question time. More importantly, our analysis shows that better temporal coverage does not necessarily translate into better answers: increasing the retrieval budget improves temporal Hit@K and Recall@K, but can reduce accuracy by introducing visually plausible distractors and uncertain caption evidence. These findings suggest that retrieval-augmented egocentric memory should not be optimized only for evidence recall, but also for the reliability, specificity, and answer-discriminative value of the retrieved context. The study motivates more structured episodic memories that move beyond raw caption retrieval toward evidence-aware representations for long-form egocentric reasoning.

papers.title_en: CA-HNM: Constraint-Aware Hard Negative Mining for Dense Retrieval with Structured Domain Models
papers.authors: Ngoc Luyen Le, Marie-Hélène Abel, Bertrand Laforge
papers.evidence: 检索流程中稠密检索器的难负例挖掘
papers.tldr: 稠密检索常用检索结果中的困难负例训练，但检索接近并不代表候选与领域结构不冲突。CA-HNM将检索候选生成与结构化领域模型中的确定性不兼容规则结合，离线构造关系、范围、目标和层级错配负例。在MOOCCubeX与Course-Skill Atlas上，CA-HNM-Pure在八种配置中的六种取得更高NDCG@10，部分分层bootstrap区间显著高于零。该工作表明约束感知负例选择的效果依赖训练目标与负例池构成。
papers.abstract_en: Dense retrievers are commonly trained with hard negatives selected from lexical or dense retrieval results. Retrieval proximity, however, does not indicate whether a candidate conflicts with explicit domain structure. We introduce CA-HNM, a constraint-aware hard-negative mining framework that combines retrieval-based candidate generation with deterministic incompatibility rules derived from a structured domain model. The framework removes known positives, constructs a local typed context around the query target, records relational, scope, target, and level mismatches, and uses the resulting candidates to fine-tune a standard dual encoder. Structured information is required only during offline negative construction. We evaluate CA-HNM on MOOCCubeX and Course-Skill Atlas with two encoders, two training losses, and ten seeds. Relative to a retrieval-rank-matched control, CA-HNM-Pure has higher mean NDCG@10 in six of eight dataset--encoder--loss configurations. Four hierarchical 95% bootstrap intervals are entirely above zero, mostly under triplet loss. In a separate experiment, CA-HNM-Mixed shows slightly higher mean NDCG@10 than a matched-mixed control on both collections. Structural variants show that changes in available structure can also change candidate eligibility and negative-pool composition. The results indicate that the contribution of constraint-aware selection depends on the training objective and the composition of the negative pool.

papers.title_en: CRIM: Composable and Reusable Item Memory for Efficient Personalized Retrieval
papers.authors: Haolin Li, Haipeng Zhang, Mang Li, Zhaohui Xia, Xun Zhu, Miao Li, Yu Zhang, Ji Wu
papers.evidence: 面向高效个性化检索的可复用条目记忆
papers.tldr: 针对个性化检索中交互历史增长导致请求输入变长、同一商品文本被反复编码、训练与推理成本高的问题，CRIM将商品级语义编码与请求级历史建模解耦：用少量可学习摘要令牌把商品压缩为可复用连续记忆，并以REC令牌在历史内引入预测监督；推理时按交互顺序组合缓存记忆并结合查询生成个性化表示。在MovieLens-1M、Qilin和新LazSeq上，CRIM在相同骨干规模下取得最优检索性能且显著降低推理成本，并通过少量在线重编码联合训练编码器。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models incur substantial training and inference costs in personalized search and recommendation, as growing interaction histories lengthen request inputs and repeatedly expose the same item text to the model. We propose \textbf{C}omposable and \textbf{R}eusable \textbf{I}tem \textbf{M}emory (CRIM), a framework that separates item-level semantic encoding from request-level history modeling. A small set of learnable summary tokens compresses each item into compact continuous memories, while segment-level readout tokens (REC tokens) introduce predictive supervision within the interaction history. These memories are independent of users and queries and can therefore be reused across requests. At inference time, CRIM composes cached memories in interaction order and incorporates an optional query to produce a personalized retrieval representation, reducing repeated item-text encoding while retaining request-dependent contextual modeling. We further introduce a joint training mechanism that combines cached memories with sampled live re-encoding. Re-encoding only a few history items per request allows the retrieval objective to jointly optimize the item and request encoders at limited computational cost, while periodic cache refreshes maintain consistency. Extensive evaluation and cost analysis on MovieLens-1M, Qilin, and our new LazSeq dataset show that CRIM achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance with substantially lower inference costs at the same backbone scale, while limiting item re-encoding during joint training. We will publicly release our code and dataset.
